entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered a helmet and I think I need to send it back. I was looking on the website and it's all so confusing. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help you look into a return. I just need to pull up your account. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Oh, um, sure. It's confusedcustomer@email.com. I just feel a bit overwhelmed by all this.

Okay, I have your order right here for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I can definitely help with this. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A fault? Oh, I don't think so. The box is unopened, I haven't even taken it out. It's just... the color isn't what I pictured. And I've been thinking, proper safety is so important, and if I'm not 100% happy with it, maybe I should just send it back. The policy online confused me. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I completely understand that getting the right product is key. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the helmet was delivered 11 days ago.
Is that bad? Am I too late? I told you, I was so confused.

Not at all. I'm looking at our policy right now, and for this item, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve this for you right now.
Oh, really? That's it? That's such a relief! Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
That's wonderful. Thank you for making it so easy, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
